author.name: Zac Kyoti
credits: Zac Kyoti: the gesture and its ColdFire source, including the LIVE REC toasts, the PERSONALIZE redraw after a flip and the stock-free order of the flip's stores, and the MKI hardware work behind it. Sam Banks: octabam integration.

presentation.label: Live-record quantize on [REC] + [PLAY]
presentation.summary: Hold [REC] and tap [PLAY] to see QUANTIZE LIVE REC in a toast; tap [PLAY] again while it is up to switch it.
presentation.overview: QUANTIZE LIVE REC decides whether live-recorded trigs snap to the steps. Stock keeps it in PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE. This module shows it on the gesture that starts live recording and lets a second tap switch it, without leaving the page you are on.
highlights: OS 1.40C only. The author tested this version from the card on his MKI (23 October 2026): the gesture, the PERSONALIZE redraw and a power cycle. 0.1.0, with the same gesture, ran on an MKII from the card and over USB.
The first [REC] + [PLAY] still starts live recording, as on stock. While live recording runs, further [REC] + [PLAY] presses do nothing on stock; here they show or invert the setting.
If a stock notification happens to be on screen while [REC] is held, the first [PLAY] inverts the setting instead of only showing it; the toast then shows the new value.
The setting is the stock global PERSONALIZE value in battery-backed memory: not saved per project or Part, and reset by an OS upgrade like the rest of PERSONALIZE.
usage: Hold [REC] and tap [PLAY]: a toast shows LIVE REC: QUANTIZED or LIVE REC: UNQUANTIZED, the current setting, and live recording starts as on the stock OS.
While the toast is still on screen (about one second), keep [REC] held and tap [PLAY] again to invert the setting; the toast reopens with the new value.
Tap [PLAY] once more while it is up to switch back, or release [REC] to close the toast; the setting stays as last shown.
Press [STOP] to end live recording. PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE > QUANTIZE LIVE REC shows and edits the same setting.

controls.name: QUANTIZE LIVE REC
controls.doc: The stock PERSONALIZE setting. QUANTIZED is the ticked QUANTIZE LIVE REC box. The module does not change its stored value or default; it only adds the [REC] + [PLAY] gesture that shows and inverts it.

limitations: OS 1.40C only. The author tested this version from the card on his MKI (23 October 2026): the gesture, the PERSONALIZE redraw and a power cycle. 0.1.0, with the same gesture, ran on an MKII from the card and over USB.
The first [REC] + [PLAY] still starts live recording, as on stock. While live recording runs, further [REC] + [PLAY] presses do nothing on stock; here they show or invert the setting.
If a stock notification happens to be on screen while [REC] is held, the first [PLAY] inverts the setting instead of only showing it; the toast then shows the new value.
The setting is the stock global PERSONALIZE value in battery-backed memory: not saved per project or Part, and reset by an OS upgrade like the rest of PERSONALIZE.

With PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE open, a flip redraws the list so the box follows at once (emulator and MKI). The author noted an occasional small empty box where the toast was right after it closes.
This is the all-or-nothing QUANTIZE LIVE REC setting, not the per-track TRIG QUANT. No effect slot, menu row or project data is added.

Over USB for beta testers: one ColdFire package with its two jmp sites; it adds no effect row or project data, so a project never names it as missing. This version's package has not run over USB on a unit (0.1.0's did, on an MKII, 15 October 2026).

resources.recorded: 23 October 2026; source assembly, the image gate and executed instructions under the ColdFire port

storage.label: ROM code and detours
storage.conditions: One position-independent linked unit of 196 bytes (code and two strings) in free ROM space, and two six-byte jmp detours over stock instructions. No RAM, no DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, per key press
processing.display: at most 28 authored instructions per press
processing.conditions: Longest path through the [PLAY] entry (invert, redraw PERSONALIZE when it is the open page, reopen the toast, then stock's [PLAY] path), counted from the source; stock routines it calls are excluded. Runs only on a [PLAY] press or [REC] release, never per frame. In ot_emu (emulator, not hardware) the longest press executed 26.

impact.conditions: A key-press handler: nothing runs between presses.

cpu.rationale: Two to about two dozen instructions on a [PLAY] press or [REC] release; no per-frame or per-sample work. 0.1.0 in ot_emu under a MIDI flood (about 1,000 messages a second and clock at 240 BPM) left the longest frame interrupt at the stock image's; emulator figures, not the unit's time.

dsp.rationale: No DSP code and no change to the DSP programs.

memory.rationale: 208 bytes of ROM; no RAM or audio memory of its own.

tests.summary: The image gate passes 36 checks on the native image of this module alone: the retired 0x400522ca site left as the original OS has it, both jmp detours and the unit's 196 bytes in place, then under the ColdFire port by the keys (MKII panel) the show, invert, invert-back, expiry and [REC]-release behaviour beside the original OS under the same keys, an open PERSONALIZE list redrawn by a flip, and a power cycle of the port keeping an inverted setting. On his MKI (23 October 2026) the author flashed that image from the card and reported the gesture, the PERSONALIZE redraw and a power cycle working.

conditions.parameterExtremes: Both values of the setting (stored 0 and 1), toast present and absent, [REC] held and not held, live recording stopped and running: every branch of the two entries.
conditions.parameterModulation: Not applicable: one global boolean reached by a key gesture; no LFO, parameter lock, scene or MIDI CC reaches it.
conditions.modeSwitching: Repeated show, invert and invert-back presses inside one toast, and [REC] release with and without a toast on screen.
conditions.maxLoad: One instance per unit (a global key gesture). The code runs once per [PLAY] press or [REC] release in the key handler, never in the frame or audio path.
conditions.inputConditions: Independent of audio. Counts cover the authored instructions only; the stock routines they call (project gate, checksum, menu redraw, notification open and close) are stock cost and excluded. Counted on the qualified image, the native card image of this module alone with every stock effect kept (MAIN OS 3a39f682b372ad1ad962cc3f327893b51db54273ac5a0690918552298a7b9328); the USB package 297f79ef (ABI 7, 364 bytes) carries the same 196-byte unit byte for byte.

regions.name: Authored ColdFire code and the two toast strings (linked unit qlr, ROM cave)
Two six-byte jmp detours written over stock instructions in place

memory.conditions: From the linked unit (196 bytes at any address; it is position independent) and the two detours. No RAM of its own: it reads and writes the stock setting word and its battery copy, and reads stock key and notification state. No heap; at most 8 bytes of stack beyond the stock key handler (two pushed arguments) before the stock calls.

hardware.summary: The author flashed the native card image of this module alone (MAIN OS 3a39f682, OS VERSION MW_QLR011) on his MKI and ran it for about five minutes. All passed: hold [REC] + tap [PLAY] shows the toast and starts live recording; a second tap while the toast is up flips the setting and another flips it back; a tap after the toast has gone only shows it; releasing [REC] closes the toast and [STOP] ends live recording; with PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE open on QUANTIZE LIVE REC the show press leaves the box alone and a flip changes it at once; a changed setting survives a power cycle.
limitations: From the card only: the USB package 297f79ef has not run on a unit; 0.1.0's USB package ran on an MKII (15 October 2026).
Not checked on this version: an MKII, grid recording, MIDI tracks, Part and project reload, combined builds with other modules.
About five minutes of use; nothing timed or recorded.
